$comment: Advisories that must not fail CI, with the reason each is accepted.
Keep this list as short as possible and re-check it on every dependency bump —
an entry is a promise to remove it, not a permanent exemption.
Everything not listed here still fails the build at high severity.
This list is intentionally EMPTY: as of the last audit every advisory
(runtime and build-only) is fixed. `scripts/audit.mjs` now FAILS the build
when an entry here no longer corresponds to a real advisory, so a fix that
lands upstream cannot leave a stale waiver behind.
